name: CapCut Film Strip Glow Text Reveal
use_when: A commercial, travel, brand, or premium social title needs a controlled shine pass.
The base video or background is dark enough for a light sweep to read cleanly.
The title is short and large enough for glow to enhance the word rather than hide it.
avoid_when: The background is bright, high contrast, or already full of glow.
The phrase is long or small and needs plain readability.
The glow appears before it reaches the word or remains after it leaves.
The effect would cover faces, product proof, UI, captions, or action.

timeline_pattern.pattern: base_video -> base_text_dark_or_colored -> duplicate_white_text -> compound_top_text -> Film_Strip_mask -> rotate_and_narrow_lines -> feather -> start_mask_off_left -> end_mask_off_right -> add_Glow_2 -> tune_glow -> qc
timeline_pattern.duplicate_rule: The glowing white text layer should align exactly with the base colored text layer.
timeline_pattern.mask_rule: The Film Strip mask creates the moving shine band; start and end outside the word so glow does not leak before or after the pass.
timeline_pattern.background_rule: Use darker or controlled backgrounds so the glow reads as a shine, not a muddy haze.

motion.rule: The shine should cross the word once, reveal clearly, and exit before the next reading task competes.

keyframe_values.mask_rotation: Rotate the Film Strip mask around 60 degrees as a starting diagonal shine angle.
keyframe_values.mask_width: Decrease the Film Strip line width until the shine feels like a narrow sweep, not a full text recolor.
keyframe_values.start_frame: A delayed start around the title beat, such as near 2 seconds in a calm commercial-style shot, can work if the word is already readable.
keyframe_values.glow_size: Glow 2 Size around 46 can be a starting value for large text.
keyframe_values.glow_intensity: Glow 2 Intensity around 20 can be a starting value; lower it if the edge blooms or compresses.

sound.rule: Use a very soft shimmer, whoosh, or no SFX; if used, it should follow the shine and stay below speech.

captions.rule: Keep ordinary captions out of the glow sweep region unless accessibility requires a separate caption track.

color.rule: Base text can be a darker project color while the masked duplicate supplies the light sweep; both states must preserve crisp letter edges.

implementation.ffmpeg: Create base text plus a duplicate bright text/glow overlay, reveal it through an animated diagonal grayscale alpha mask with alphamerge, blur a separate duplicate for glow, and inspect contact frames for pre-glow, tail-glow, or alpha edge contamination.
implementation.remotion: Build a GlowSweepText component with absolute duplicate text, maskAngle, maskWidth, CSS mask-image/clip-path progress keyframes, separately masked glow duplicate, glowSize, glowIntensity, safeRegion, captionSuppression, and transparent overlay export when needed.
implementation.blender: Use duplicate text materials, an animated diagonal mask, and compositor glow/bloom; limit bloom so text remains readable.
implementation.capcut_equivalent: Create base text, duplicate it in white, compound the duplicate, add Video > Mask > Film Strip, rotate around 60, narrow the lines, feather the mask, keyframe the mask from fully left to fully right, add Glow 2, and tune Size/Intensity around 46/20 only if readability holds.
implementation.premiere_equivalent: Duplicate Essential Graphics text, add a diagonal masked bright layer with Glow, animate the mask across the word, and compare against a no-glow version.

common_mistakes: Letting glow appear on the left side before the mask reaches the word.
Ending the mask while glow still sits on the text.
Using the shine on bright footage where the sweep is invisible or muddy.
Increasing glow until the letter edges bloom and compress.
Adding the effect to long captions instead of short title text.
qc: Does the glow start off-word and end off-word with no leakage?
Is the title readable before, during, and after the shine?
Do Glow 2 size and intensity preserve crisp edges at phone size?
Does the effect avoid faces, captions, product UI, proof, and action?
Does any shimmer or whoosh stay below speech and end with the shine?
If the shine is exported separately, does it preserve alpha and stay clean over bright and dark backgrounds?
